copy.title: Steelok Locksmiths | The Steelok Branch Network
copy.description: Steelok Locksmiths — the brand site for our seven branches from the Black Country to the Severn Vale. Hardware-first locksmithing: the right lock, correctly fitted, in Arnold, Bloxwich, Burntwood, Burton, Cheltenham, Great Malvern and Horwich.
copy.topbar: Hardware-first locksmithing · BS3621 mortice · TS007 3-star cylinders
copy.h1: It starts with the right lock
copy.lead: Most lock problems are really hardware problems — the wrong cylinder, a tired mechanism, a fitting done in a hurry. Steelok branches from the Black Country to the Severn Vale work the other way round: specify the right hardware first, fit it properly, and the security looks after itself.
copy.heroNote: {n} branches across the Midlands and the North West, all working to the same fitting standard.

coverage.heading: Where you'll find a Steelok branch
coverage.intro: Seven branches, most of them in the towns that built things — Bloxwich locks, Burton brewing, Horwich railway works. Each branch keeps its own number; the areas below are its regular patch.

services.heading: The work, in order of how often locks actually fail
services.intro: Emergencies get covered — but half of Steelok's diary is upgrading and fitting hardware so the emergency never happens.
featured: New BS3621 mortice locks and TS007 3-star cylinders, specified to your door, not off the shelf.
Tired or non-compliant hardware swapped for lockage your insurer will actually recognise.
Sticking mortices, sagging multipoints, stiff cylinders — repaired where repair is honest, replaced where it isn't.
Espagnolette and shootbolt mechanisms serviced or renewed to keep casements compliant.
24/7 call-out when it does go wrong — attended with a van stocked for a first-visit fix.
Non-destructive entry, then a proper look at why the lock failed before we leave.
Home and business safes anchored and rated correctly for what they'll hold.

why.heading: The Steelok way of doing a job
points: Every quote names the exact hardware going on your door — brand, grade and standard — so you know what you're paying for.
A 3-star cylinder fitted proud of the handle is a 0-star cylinder. Steelok engineers are measured on the fit, not just the sale.
If a £15 part saves a £150 mechanism, that's the job we'll quote. Replacement is a recommendation, never a reflex.
The same fitting standards and the same price book from Arnold to Great Malvern.

cta.heading: Get the hardware question answered properly
cta.sub: Your local Steelok branch will tell you what's on your door now, and what should be.

copy.footerBlurb: The brand site for Steelok Locksmiths — seven hardware-first branches across the Midlands and North West, fitting locks to the standard they're rated for.
